thread:
Mira (design): Quick sync: propose a small persistent actions area in the trace header for 'Copy trace link', 'Export JSON', 'Open in new tab'. We want fast access without cluttering the header.
Devon (product): Useful, +1. Concern: on narrow screens the header real estate is tight. Can we collapse into a single kebab menu on mobile?
Sana (eng-ux): Plan: desktop shows icon buttons with labels on hover; mobile shows a single actions chevron that opens a bottom sheet with the same CTAs. Keeps parity.
Ben (eng-runtime): FYI exports for huge traces start a background job. UI needs to show progress and whether it's a streaming export or a snapshot. Also include trace_id in the payload so support can match.
Olivia (accessibility): Accessibility notes: all actions must be keyboard-focusable, provide aria-labels with the trace id (e.g., "Copy trace link for 1980001111"), and use aria-live for completion to announce "Export ready". Icon-only buttons need visible focus rings and 4.5:1 contrast.
Kai (eng-sre): For archived traces, disable export and show tooltip "Export unavailable for archived traces" with link to docs. Also log telemetry when users try to export archived traces so we can detect confusion.
Arjun (support): If users copy link, include the short link in a toast with a 'Copy ID' button. Support often receives screenshots without context, that small step reduces back-and-forth. Also suggest adding a 'Report with context' option to prefill a ticket with link + selected stack frames.
Mira (design): Good idea. Microcopy: should CTA be 'Copy trace link' or 'Copy share link'? Which is less ambiguous?
Devon (product): 'Copy trace link' is clearer to me. We'll track analytics for copy vs export actions to prioritize features.
Sana (eng-ux): Interaction detail: collapsed stack frames show a "+N frames" affordance. Make that toggleable via Enter/Space and add a keyboard shortcut to expand all frames (Ctrl+Shift+U). Also animate height changes to avoid layout jumps.
Ben (eng-runtime): Backend can return stack_frame_count and a preview frames array to avoid heavy payloads. Expand-all fetches remaining frames lazily. Export JSON will include correlation_ids, services, and truncated stack_frames unless user requests full.
Olivia (accessibility): Add visually-hidden text on copy buttons: "Copy trace link for request 1980001111" so screenreaders get the ID. Also ensure actions in the bottom sheet trap focus and restore focus to the trigger on close.
Sana (eng-ux): I'll update mocks: desktop header with icon buttons, mobile bottom sheet, and the collapsed frame interactions. Include keyboard-flow GIF for the PR.
copybot: Reminder: attach contrast screenshots and keyboard nav test cases to the design PR.
Mira (design): Action items: (1) Sana mock update by EOD, (2) Ben to prototype export endpoint and short-link redirect, (3) Olivia to publish a11y checklist, (4) Devon to add analytics events.
Ben (eng-runtime): I'll validate payload shape and ping here when ready. Export JSON example in spec: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/trace/1980001111/export > trace.json
Mira (design): Thanks everyone. We'll iterate after the a11y spec. :thumbsup:
